hero.badge: Serving communities in Andhra Pradesh since 1992
hero.lede: Dedicated to the socio-economic advancement and sustainable development of vulnerable communities, tribal groups, Dalits, women and children across Nandyal and Kurnool districts.

whoWeAre.title: A grassroots organisation, rooted in its district
whoWeAre.body: Chaithanya Kala Bharathi is a non-governmental organisation started in 1992 by a group of social activists and experienced social workers — local people, familiar with the socio-economic realities of the area. The organisation renders social services for tribal communities, Dalits and other vulnerable groups including women, children and people with disabilities.
whoWeAre.body2: It is led by Prof. R. Ratna Swamy and Mr. V. V. Bhaskar, both long identified in the operational area for their standing social service through CKB. We work alongside Gram Panchayats, Anganwadis (ICDS), Primary Health Centres and philanthropic partners.
points: Registered since 1992 with 12A, 80G, CSR and FCRA approvals
Working in Kurnool and Nandyal districts (erstwhile Kurnool district)
Serving tribal communities, Dalits, women, children and people with disabilities
